question: In which of the following years was the first train run in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1853**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1853, the first passenger train in India run from Bombay (Bombay, now Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus) to Thane.
 
• Indian Railways:
 
 
• Lord Dalhousie introduced railways in India in 1853.
 
• Indian Railway Board was established in March 1905. 
 
• Indian Railway was nationalised in 1951.
 
• The first Indian railway line in India was operated for public traffic in 1853 between Mumbai and Thane over a distance of 34 km.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Railways have been divided into 18 zones.
 
• Ashwini Vaishnav is the current Minister of Railways (July 2021).
 
• The first electric train in India was ‘Deccan Queen’.
 
 
• It was introduced in 1929 between Bombay and Poona.
